rulings.restated: Enter the amount from f1040 line 15.
rulings.model: IRS line 1 says to enter line 3 of the Foreign Earned Income Tax Worksheet instead when filing Form 2555; the restatement always uses Form 1040 line 15.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. i1040sd p. 15, line 1: "Enter your taxable income from Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 15. (However, if you are filing Form 2555 (relating to foreign earned income), enter instead the amount from line 3 of the Foreign Earned Income Tax Worksheet in the instructions for Form 1040, line 16.)". The Form 2555 alternative is never reached on a return the tool computes: the exclusion is reported on Schedule 1, line 8d (i1040gi p. 91: "Foreign earned income exclusion and housing exclusion from Form 2555"), refused by s1.line8_other (forms/2025/s1.yaml: "lines 8a, 8d, 8e, 8k to 8q and 8s to 8v are refused by s1.line8_other"); the housing deduction (Schedule 1, line 24j) is refused at Form 1040 line 10 ("lines 24b to 24z are outside this tool"); and a filer who answers that Form 2555 is filed is refused at Schedule 1-A line 2a (forms/2025/s1a.yaml, gate sa.excluded_income, i1040gi p. 101). The worksheet note records Form 2555 as outside scope. The restatement says what the page says for every return the tool computes; as round 2. No change.
